title: Intake reading
description: The AI-010 intake fields with a 0-to-1 confidence for trade and for job type and no other field (AI-022, D-492, D-493). The stand-in AI validates its output against this file, the Rust types are checked against it and the request's output_config sends it without $schema and $id; it uses only keywords the Claude API supports, so ranges and length caps live in code (D-2760). Trade and job type are checked against the catalog in code (AI-005).

trade_confidence.description: A confidence from 0 to 1; the range is checked in code, not here (D-2760).

job_type_confidence.description: A confidence from 0 to 1; the range is checked in code, not here (D-2760).
